description: This is a test class for the EmployeeTerminationDao component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for saving and retrieving employee termination records and termination reasons, utilizing mocks and fixtures.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing EmployeeTerminationDao functions related to employee termination records and reasons.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeTerminationDao, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new EmployeeTerminationRecord and verifies its properties after persistence.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests retrieving an EmployeeTerminationRecord and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of termination reasons and verifies their count and names.
